title: Don't shut only school in village due to unsafe building, inadequate toilets; fix it instead: MP High Court
description: The Madhya Pradesh High Court recently held that the sole school in a village should not be shut down over inadequate infrastructure and safety concerns [Manggi Bai Kole & Ors. & The State of Madhya Pradesh & Ors.].Instead, the local elected representatives and villagers should work together to address the deficiencies, the Court directed.A bench of acting Chief Justice Vivek Rusia and Justice Pradeep Mittal observed that while the school suffered from serious deficiencies, including
